entries.description: Bright two-note Apple Pay confirm chime — checkout success, payment accepted, 'transaction complete' beats.
use: wallet or card tap in a UI mockup
avoid: as a big milestone — it is a polite chime, not a fanfare
layering with other success dings

entries.description: Classic ka-ching till with drawer clack — revenue, sale closed, money-on-screen reveals.
use: price tag or cart total appears
avoid: serious finance analysis — reads as novelty
repeating per item in a long list

entries.description: Rising electronic whine that builds and peaks — a meter filling, battery charging, power building before a reveal.
avoid: under calm narration with no buildup payoff

entries.description: Deep sub-heavy cinematic boom with long tail — title cards, hard cuts, trailer-style reveals.
use: hard cut to a new section
avoid: under intimate or quiet storytelling
stacking two booms within a second

entries.description: Soft plastic hardware click with slight body — pressing a physical button, switch or remote on screen.
use: toggle flips in a product demo
avoid: punchy comedic emphasis — it is quiet and dry
rhythmic repetition that turns into ticking

entries.description: Steady mechanical clock tick loop — a countdown, deadline or waiting beat under narration.
avoid: long stretches under dialogue — becomes hypnotic and distracting
light comedic scenes where it feels ominous

entries.description: Camera flash pop with sharp shutter snap — photo captured, screenshot taken, freeze-frame moment.
avoid: as a heavy impact — it is bright and small
pairing with a flashy white transition on every beat

entries.description: Gritty interlocking gear grind, metallic and low — machinery starting, systems grinding into motion.
avoid: delicate or premium product shots
under soft-spoken narration where grit clashes

entries.description: Stuttering digital corruption bed with bitcrushed snaps — screen tearing, broken data, system failure visuals.
use: text or image corrupts on screen
avoid: clean corporate explainers — reads as malfunction
under voiceover without ducking the mids

entries.description: Tiny bright digital tick with glassy top end — cursor moving, selection snapping, fast UI actions.
avoid: for heavy or final confirmations
dense repetition on every on-screen element

entries.description: Muted low digital click, soft and round — committing an action, confirm button, deeper UI step.
avoid: as the only rhythm in a fast montage — too soft to lead
bright playful scenes where it feels dull

entries.description: Dry mouse-button click, thin and short — someone clicking through an app, browser or spreadsheet.

avoid: as an impact or emphasis hit
uncountable repetition without rhythm

entries.description: Soft touchscreen tap-typing bed — someone texting on a phone, search bar filling, message composing.
use: text message being typed on screen
avoid: under dense narration — continuous taps compete
as a one-shot accent

entries.description: Round plastic pop as something appears — notification bounces in, tooltip opens, card pops up.

every single element entrance, becomes noisy

entries.description: Short clipped radio beep, dry and square — comms opening, alert acknowledged, walkie-talkie cue.

avoid: warm friendly confirmations — it is clinical
layering with other beeps into a siren feel

entries.description: Tight metallic ratchet notch, one firm click — settings locking in, dial stepping, tool tightening.
use: dial or slider snaps to value
avoid: soft organic scenes
fast repeats — it is a single decisive notch

entries.description: Clean mid-pitch digital click, quick and unobtrusive — the default click for buttons and tab switches.
use: tab switch in a UI mockup
button press in an app demo
avoid: as an impact or reveal

entries.description: Pitch-dropping time-stretch swirl — speed ramps down into slow motion, or footage drops into a dramatic beat.

entries.description: Rapid stuttered repeat with digital grit — audio or video caught buffering, a beat getting stuck.
avoid: polished corporate tone
more than once per video — the joke wears out

entries.description: Mechanical keyboard clatter bed, steady keystrokes — coding, writing, search terms entered on a desktop.

entries.description: Soft rising bloop-pop with a friendly tail — small success toasts, chips appearing, gentle confirmations.

entries.description: Minecraft creeper hiss into a chunky blocky explosion — an 'uh oh' beat, plan blowing up, sudden chaos.

entries.description: Chirpy Nintendo eShop style purchase chime — buying something in a game or app, store confirmation.

entries.description: Chunky console menu select click with a bright ping — picking an option in a game menu or app.

selection confirms on a stylized UI

entries.description: Wooden Minecraft UI button clunk — a menu option pressed in blocky game-style graphics.

entries.description: Minecraft chest creak and open with loot sparkle — a container of goodies revealed, reward unlocked.

bonus damage or big multiplier hit

entries.description: Dull Minecraft-style damage thud, dry and blocky — a hit connecting, damage dealing in gameplay.

avoid: serious narrator tone — the warble reads comic

entries.description: Soft rising app-open swell — a phone screen opens, home menu slides in, app launches.
avoid: big trailer transitions — it is gentle
as an impact hit

entries.description: Retro chiptune two-note ding — stat restored, correct answer, item obtained in a pokemon-style beat.
avoid: modern premium product demos — reads chiptune-nostalgic
serious tone overall

entries.description: Breathy airy whoosh with soft highs — a light swipe between scenes, a title drifting in.
avoid: heavy action transitions — it has no weight
on every cut, becomes a nervous tic

entries.description: Low ominous build that swells in pitch and volume — approaching threat, reveal of a problem, pre-drop tension.
use: build to a reveal or drop
tension rises before a stat lands
avoid: light or upbeat segments — it darkens everything
running past the cut with no payoff

entries.description: Short sub-bass punch with weight, little high end — a claim landing hard, a logo or stat thumping in.
avoid: on laptop speakers it may vanish — pair with a click

entries.description: Long low cinematic whoosh with a dark tail — a heavy camera move, big scene change.
use: camera whips past a large subject
avoid: fast snappy cuts — it takes seconds to resolve
under quiet dialogue without ducking

entries.description: Explosive energy burst with a bright crack and fast decay — a power-up, a sudden blast of motion or light.
avoid: calm explainers — it is aggressive
repeated bursts back to back, becomes fatiguing

entries.description: Shimmering airy swell with a soft choir-like top — an uplifting build into a hopeful or wondrous reveal.
use: slow transition into a brighter section
avoid: tension or threat beats — it lifts rather than darkens
short cuts where the swell has no room

entries.description: Hit-and-whoosh combo that slams then sweeps forward — a hard section change with forward momentum.
use: hard cut into a new topic
avoid: soft or reflective transitions

entries.description: Ringing metallic clang with a long shimmer — metal striking metal, an industrial or mechanical impact.
avoid: warm human-centered storytelling
pairing with soft UI sounds in one beat

entries.description: Scraping metallic rise that tightens into a peak — machinery accelerating, tech building to a reveal.
avoid: gentle or human-warm content
extending past the reveal with no cut

entries.description: Warping pitch-bend rise with an eerie sway — a realization forming, a mind racing, a twist approaching.
use: thought or idea forming on screen
avoid: straightforward factual segments — it implies weirdness
comedic tone where the eeriness clashes

entries.description: Brass-and-strings orchestral stab with reverb — a dramatic punchline, epic reveal, mock-cinematic moment.
avoid: quick technical explainers — it is deliberately grand
stacking with other epic hits

entries.description: Long escalating drone that climbs to a wall of noise — a long suspense build into a hard reveal.
use: long build across a montage into a payoff
sustained suspense under a story beat
avoid: short 1-2s transitions — use a short riser
under important dialogue for the full 14s

entries.description: Reverb-drenched swell that widens and lifts — a spacious build into a scene change or emotional peak.
use: build into an emotional or dramatic cut
transition into a big set piece
avoid: dialogue-dense passages — the tail washes over speech
sections that need a clean hard cut

entries.description: Quick tight whoosh with a clean taper — a fast object swipe, smaller transition, text flipping in.
avoid: big heavy transitions — too small
on every single cut, becomes mechanical
